blind.description: A modular wall segment with an open rectangular doorway. It is constructed from dark charcoal-grey ashlar stone blocks forming two upright posts/jambs supporting a horizontal dark red painted lintel beam with angled corner brackets, topped by two further courses of dark stone and a stone coping cap. The geometry is clean, continuous, and solid with no unattached, melted, or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A long, thin dark grey rectangular bar with slightly chamfered corners, matching the top edge of a stone wall section.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.6 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 9.5 feet tall) and nearly as wide as the figure is tall (roughly 5 feet wide).
